verdict.rationale: The evidence documents policy and approval workflows and lets users ask why transactions were flagged or declined. That is policy enforcement, not budget allocation. Nothing in the pack shows allocating budgets to teams or projects, or setting card limits that enforce such budgets. The card-management evidence covers only viewing card status and details, so the available support is adjacent rather than direct.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can allocate budgets to teams and projects and have card limits and approvals actually enforce them
